summary: NetEase filed a Form 6-K furnishing its monthly Hong Kong Stock Exchange return for October 2026, covering movements in authorised and issued share capital. Authorised capital stayed at 1,000,300,000,000 ordinary shares of US$0.0001 par (US$100,030,000 total). Issued shares excluding treasury fell 176,855 to 3,201,475,296, with treasury shares rising by the same amount to 10,580,360, leaving total issued unchanged at 3,212,055,656. The company confirmed compliance with the 25% minimum public float. This is a routine HKEX monthly return equivalent to a US share-capital update, with no special-situation event; no action or risk-arb angle.
